randomization.selection_algorithm: For four ordered five-item menus, index_i = floor(seed / 5^i) mod 5, with i = 0 setting, 1 event, 2 lighting, 3 camera_composition.

schema_normalization.reason: The first generator preflight rejected three descriptive open-dimension labels as unknown before producing any candidate pack.
schema_normalization.replacement: wardrobe, material_behavior, and secondary_set_dressing were mapped mechanically to the allowed color, material, and atmosphere dimensions without changing the selected concept or baseline prompt.

required_gates.pass_condition: The complete instrument is visibly comparable to the standing adult and reads as roughly human-height or taller rather than seated-player cello scale.
The elongated neck, fingerboard, pegbox, and scroll are visibly continuous above the large body.
A visible endpin physically connects the instrument base to the floor and clearly supports the upright instrument.
One hand visibly fingers the neck while the other visibly bows the strings, with plausible contact and posture.
The combined standing-player scale, tall shoulder/neck geometry, large lower bouts, and floor-supported performance relation unambiguously distinguish a double bass from a cello.
